description: Source file implementing DemuxerStreamFsFCC class with file I/O operations, configuration management, and helper functions for media stream control within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

classes.name: DemuxerStreamFsFCC
classes.description: Class providing file-based media stream control and status management within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Initializes or opens the stream; currently a placeholder returning OK.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the stream; currently a placeholder returning OK.

methods.name: setChannel
methods.description: Sets the media channel by writing to a configuration file.

methods.name: getChannel
methods.description: Retrieves the current media channel from a configuration file.

methods.name: setSeekPosInSeconds
methods.description: Sets the seek position in seconds by writing to a file.

methods.name: getSeek
methods.description: Reads seek position and size information from a file into a SeekType structure.

methods.name: setTrickPlaySpeed
methods.description: Sets the trick play speed by writing to a file.

methods.name: getTrickPlaySpeed
methods.description: Reads the trick play speed from a file.

methods.name: getStreamStatus
methods.description: Retrieves stream status information such as source loss and count.

methods.name: getTrickPlayFile
methods.description: Returns the filename used for trick play.
